# MehyarSoft LLC

> Founder-led software, systems, and AI automation for businesses worldwide
> that want more customers, faster follow-up, and less manual work.

## What this site is

- **MehyarSoft** (https://mehyar.us) is the agency site of MehyarSoft LLC,
  a founder-led software, systems, and AI automation firm headquartered in
  Brooklyn, New York, serving businesses worldwide through remote-first
  delivery.
- Services: websites, customer apps, booking systems, AI follow-up, phone
  care, CRM cleanup, systems integration, and automation for businesses
  losing customers to missed calls, weak websites, manual work, and
  disconnected tools.
- Typical clients: local service businesses, agencies, clinics, and
  regulated teams that need a practical technical owner to clean up the
  path from prospect to paid customer.

## Pricing (from the site's own FAQ)

- Tech Audit: from $150
- Website Diagnosis Report: $250
- Custom builds: $1,000–$25,000
- Retainers: $500–$3,500/month
- Hourly advisory: $150/hour

## Products we own

MehyarSoft LLC ships one-time digital products on *.mehyar.us subdomains
(PureTap, SproutScore, HustleKit, TrueSketch, CreditFix Kit, PLR Vault,
PromptPack, and others). The full directory is at https://mehyar.us/apps.

## Compliance

- No income guarantees or earnings claims are made anywhere on this site.
- This is a service business: engagements are scoped, priced, and
  documented per client.
